messages:
marta: FYI seeing bursty ECC/Xid 126 on usw2-gpu-pool last hour. 3 nodes had short 30-60s spikes, DCGM exporter fired alerts then recovered. Don't want unnecessary node drains. Thoughts on changing Prom rules to score signals instead of immediate fire?

arun: Can you paste the node IDs and exporter output? Curious if it's same card index across nodes or multiple cards.

marta: Nodes: gnode-17, gnode-59, gnode-130. Exporter logs show repeated 'Xid 126' events with short interarrival (~20s). Patchy, not sustained. I'll attach snippet.

marta: ```
# dcgm-exporter sample
{node="gnode-17", card="0"} dcgm_xid_errors_total 5
{node="gnode-17", card="0"} dcgm_ecc_errors_corrected_total 12
``` 

jia: +1 to scoring. Proposal: require 3 windows: (1) per-card streak > 3 within 5m, (2) cluster-wide card-affinity for same job (label job_id) >2 cards, (3) persistent >2m before auto-drain. If only a transient burst, mark ticket but suppress pager.

sam: How would that look in Prom rules? We should avoid long evals on Prom to not add load.

jia: Example rule (pseudo):

```
- alert: DCGM_ErrantGPU_Streak
  expr: increase(dcgm_xid_errors_total[5m]) > 3
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: warning
    action: investigate
  annotations:
    runbook: /runbooks/gpu-xid-streak
```

Then a composite alert that joins by job_id/card and only escalates to page if count_over_time(streak_alert[10m]) >= 2 and distinct_cards_by_job >= 2.

arun: I like distinct_cards_by_job filtering. Where do we get job_id label? k8s exporter has pod_owner or node exporter has kube labels. We need to ensure exporter relabels include pod annotations.

marta: We already have label relabeling on the tailers for gke pods. For Dedicated nodes it's spotty though.

dcgm-exporter-bot: alert: gnode-59 card 0 had Xid126 spike (5 events in 4m). Suggest check temp and ECC trend. https://metrics/redwood/gpu/gnode-59

sam: Ops plan: 1) roll rule change to non-paging severity for 24h, 2) collect histograms of streak length + job affinity, 3) if persistent across nodes in same job escalate to page + automated drain. I'll open a PR to staging Prom.

marta: Thanks. PR link? I'll add the affected nodes to the nightly sweep to avoid surprise RMA.

arun: +1 on PR. Also can we add a particle 'cooldown' label so repeated flaps within 1h don't re-alert? :thinking: 

jia: Yep we can use recording rule to set label cooldown_until = time() + 3600 and check absent(cooldown) before firing.

sam: I'll make the PR and include examples. ping @oncall-rotation when merged.

marta: :thumbsup:
